Questions

Good questions, straight answers

What is a mobile LED billboard truck?

It's a truck fitted with large, high-resolution digital LED screens that drives your ad through the areas where your audience lives, works and gathers, or parks it at an event or store. It's out-of-home (OOH) advertising that goes to the people instead of waiting for them to drive past.

How much does it cost to rent an LED billboard truck in Dallas?

Pricing depends on the campaign length (daily, weekly or monthly), the hours per day and the city. Longer campaigns cost less per day. Tell us your goals and dates and we'll send a custom quote.

How long can a campaign run?

From a single day for a launch or event, to a week for a promotion, to a month or longer for sustained brand awareness.

Can I choose where the truck goes?

Yes. Every campaign gets a custom route planned around your audience: business districts, neighborhoods, events, competitor locations or high-traffic corridors. The truck can also park at a set location.

Can I change my ad during the campaign?

Yes. Our digital screens can show static images, video or animated content, and you can rotate several ads or update your creative during the campaign.

Do you run campaigns outside Dallas?

Yes. We're based in Dallas–Fort Worth and run campaigns across Texas, including Houston, Austin and San Antonio, as well as in other states.

How do I track the results?

You'll receive campaign photos and a report showing where and when your ad ran. Adding a QR code, short URL or promo code to your ad makes responses easy to measure.

Do you work with advertising agencies?

Yes. We regularly support media and advertising agencies adding mobile billboards to their clients' campaigns.
